utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven't heard much directly, but people are saying it might be more talk than action.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Actually, it's definitely happening—just moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll be there, and I think we'll get a lot done.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Well, that's good to know. I'll try to stop by, then—maybe I can finally meet some folks properly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Vik, you're just the person I was looking for! There's a repair drive this Saturday and we'd love your help fixing things around the neighborhood.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, absolutely! I'm gathering tools and volunteers for the repair drive this Saturday morning. We'll need help fixing shelves, painting, and cleaning up.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's fantastic, Vik! I'll spread the word to a few more folks and meet you Saturday morning with my toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I'm late. I'm in for the repair drive—what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane! I was planning to start around 9 AM. Got my tool kit and that old drill all ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, 9 AM works for me. Need me to bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's Sunday now, at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Wait, I thought it was Saturday! Guess I got my days mixed up again. Did I bring my wrench? I can't remember...

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, it's Sunday at the community center. Don't worry about the wrench—we'll have tools there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, Tess, are you sure this repair drive is going to fix the issue, or is it just another quick fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, I double-checked with Uli—it's 9 AM tomorrow, and we're focusing on lasting repairs, not just quick fixes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You double-checked with Uli? Fine, but I still need to see it for myself before I believe it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, the old oak tree is near the school, so it'll be perfect for parents to stop by after pickup. Do you think we could time it to start right when school lets out?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That timing sounds ideal, Faye. I'll make sure the supplies are ready to go by then.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Wonderful! I'll spread the word to other parents that we're all set for pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, you said the gear's by the old oak tree? I thought we were moving everything to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, I just checked with Cleo and she said it's still by the old oak tree. Maybe the move got postponed?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Are you sure about that? I heard it was supposed to be at the community center on Sunday, not the oak tree.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, Bo, I’m a bit frazzled—did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? I hope everyone got the memo, because my calendar’s all thrown off.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, Sunday? I thought it was tomorrow at 9—are you sure? I don't have time to sort this out right now, can you just text me the time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, it's Sunday at 10 AM at the community center—I'll text you right now. Let me just double-check I've got it right.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Ira! I'm Sam. I heard about the repair drive and was wondering if you need any help getting things organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh hey Sam! Glad you're interested — I'm actually about to post some flyers around the neighborhood, we could definitely use an extra hand if you're free.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, I'm free right now! Where should we start putting up those flyers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Eli, are you still planning to bring that lamp and toaster to the repair drive? I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, that's what I heard too. I adjusted my schedule accordingly — I'll be there Sunday morning with the lamp and toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll be there too. Maybe we can sit together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, a repair drive? I think I need some screws... or maybe bolts? Let me check my list... actually, I might have left it at home.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Saturday morning, starting at 9. I can help you find the right screws if you bring your list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Saturday at 9? I'll try to remember... but where is it again? I always forget the spot.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Rosa, have you heard? The repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center! Much better spot, I think.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I made the call myself—Sunday at the community center gives us more space and shelter if the weather turns.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, aren't you the smart one to think of that! I was worried we'd be stuck out on the porch if it rained.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Vik, I've just been checking what we have for the repair drive. Do you know what parts we're short on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I've been telling everyone we're fixing shelves, painting, and cleaning—so we'll need paintbrushes, screws, and cleaning supplies for sure. Saturday morning is when it all happens!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, I've already got paintbrushes and a few boxes of screws in my inventory. I can mark down the cleaning supplies as needed!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, a repair drive—I think I have some spare parts somewhere, but I can't remember where I put them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: You have spare parts? That's great—maybe we can actually get something done if we pool our stuff together.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Pool stuff together? That sounds like a good idea, but I'd need to find my toolbox first—I think I left it in the garage... or was it the shed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Leo, I'm in a rush—what's the one thing you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Just bring some basic tools if you can, and remember it's now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, tools on Sunday. I'll be there if I can swing it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, are you planning to help out with the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I heard it's been moved to Sunday at the community center. I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Oh, Sunday? Good to know, thanks Eli! I'll spread the word so nobody shows up on the wrong day.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Hana, I'm just heading to the grocery store to put up flyers for the repair drive—want to come along and help spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I'd love to help! Are the flyers mentioning the 9 AM start time? I want to make sure it's consistent.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I made sure they all say 9 AM sharp. Thanks for double-checking, Hana!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mina! I was thinking we should time the repair drive with school pickup so more parents can join.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought it was moved to Sunday at the community center. How does school pickup fit into that?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, I hadn't heard that! I was talking to Cleo and Opal about keeping it at the old oak tree to match school hours. Maybe we need to double-check the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, are you coming to the repair drive too? I'll be a little late, but I'm definitely showing up.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, I'm on my way to the old oak tree — Cleo confirmed the supplies are still set up there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh, the old oak tree—good spot. I'll catch up once I grab my paintbrush.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Kira, I've got my tool kit and that old drill I fixed up ready for the repair drive. Need me to help with anything?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on, Gus, are you sure that repair drive is even gonna work? I've heard about these things falling apart halfway through.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Don't worry, Kira, I've got plenty of tools and know-how to keep things running smooth. We'll make it work!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Jules! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're all pitching in to fix up broken stuff around the neighborhood — it'll be a blast!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, totally! I've been telling everyone about it. Gus already offered to bring his tool kit, and I'm hoping more neighbors will join in too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome Jules! I just talked to Leo and Oren too — they're both on board. This is really coming together!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Tess, just a heads-up: the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thanks for letting me know, Mara! I was just telling Kira that a good repair drive beats any quick fix—Sunday at the community center sounds perfect!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, Tess! And Faye suggested we coordinate with school pickup times, so let me know if that helps you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Rosa! Did you remember to bring a spare screwdriver? I think I had one, but I might've swapped it for a bagel at the bakery... or was that last week?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hey Oren! I don't have a spare screwdriver on me, but don't worry — the repair drive's moved to Sunday at the community center now, so you'll have time to find that bagel swap!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday? Oh good, I wrote down Saturday on my arm in pen, but I guess that washed off when I watered Mrs. Chen's plants.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey, just wanted to let you know the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, Sunday? That's actually better for me. Thanks for letting me know, Rey.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Are you planning to bring anything to the repair drive?
